			}

				this.textMesh.text = "Time Scale : " + Math.Round((double)Time.timeScale, 2).ToString();

			}
			Time.fixedDeltaTime = 0.02f * Time.timeScale;
			if (this.textMesh != null)
			{
				this.textMesh.text = "Time Scale : " + Math.Round((double)Time.timeScale, 2).ToString();
			}
		}
	}

using System;
using UnityEngine;

// Token: 0x02000156 RID: 342
public static class AnimationAdjustmentFinder
{
	// Token: 0x060008FF RID: 2303 RVA: 0x00022934 File Offset: 0x00020B34
	public static AnimationAdjustmentState GetState(PlayerArms arms, PlayerMovement movement)
	{
		PlayerAnimationAdjustmentSettings settings;
		float normalizedTime;
		if (arms.legOverride)
		{
			AnimationAdjustmentFinder.GetStateFromController(movement.PlayerAnimator, 0, movement.state == PlayerMovement.State.Transition, movement.TargetAnimationName, out settings, out normalizedTime);
		}
		else
		{
			AnimationAdjustmentFinder.GetStateFromController(arms.PlayerAnimator, 1, arms.state == PlayerArms.State.Transition, arms.TargetAnimationName, out settings, out normalizedTime);
		}
		return new AnimationAdjustmentState(settings, normalizedTime);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000900 RID: 2304 RVA: 0x00022990 File Offset: 0x00020B90
	private static void GetStateFromController(Animator animator, int animationLayer, bool isTransitionState, string cachedAnimationName, out PlayerAnimationAdjustmentSettings settings, out float normalizedTime)
	{
		if (isTransitionState || animator.IsInTransition(animationLayer))
		{
			if (cachedAnimationName.IsNullOrEmpty())
			{
				settings = null;
			}
			else
			{
				settings = PlayerAnimationAdjustments.Instance.Get(cachedAnimationName);
			}
			normalizedTime = 0f;
			return;
		}
		AnimatorStateInfo currentAnimatorStateInfo = animator.GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(animationLayer);
		settings = PlayerAnimationAdjustments.Instance.Get(currentAnimatorStateInfo);
		normalizedTime = currentAnimatorStateInfo.normalizedTime;
	}

	// Token: 0x06000901 RID: 2305 RVA: 0x000229F0 File Offset: 0x00020BF0
	public static PlayerAnimationFemaleTweaks GetFemaleTweaks(PlayerArms arms, PlayerMovement movement)
	{
		AnimationAdjustmentState state = AnimationAdjustmentFinder.GetState(arms, movement);
		if (state.settings == null)
		{
			return null;
		}
		return state.settings.FemaleTweaks;
	}
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using GodPalette;
using UnityEngine;

// Token: 0x020000A3 RID: 163
public static class AppearanceColorsHandler
{
	// Token: 0x0600042C RID: 1068 RVA: 0x0000FAF0 File Offset: 0x0000DCF0
	public static Color[] AllocateColorsWithDefaults(SkinID skinID)
	{
		List<SkinColorDescriptor> orderedColorDescriptors = SkinDatabase.Instance.GetSkinDescriptor(skinID).GetOrderedColorDescriptors();
		Color[] array = new Color[orderedColorDescriptors.Count];
		for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
		{
			array[i] = orderedColorDescriptors[i].defaultColor;
		}
		return array;
	}

	// Token: 0x0600042D RID: 1069 RVA: 0x0000FB3C File Offset: 0x0000DD3C
	public static Texture2D GenerateTexture(SkinID skin, Color[] colorSet)
	{
		if (colorSet == null || colorSet.Length != 8)
		{
			throw new ArgumentException("Colorset not properly generated");
		}
		Color[] originalColors = AppearanceColorsHandler.ExpandColorSet(skin, colorSet);
		return new PaletteGenerator(32, 4, 4).Generate(originalColors, true, null);
	}

	// Token: 0x0600042E RID: 1070 RVA: 0x0000FB78 File Offset: 0x0000DD78
	public static Color[] ExpandColorSet(SkinID skin, Color[] colorSet)
	{
		List<SkinColorDescriptor> orderedColorDescriptors = SkinDatabase.Instance.GetSkinDescriptor(skin).GetOrderedColorDescriptors();
		Color[] array = new Color[colorSet.Length * 2];
		int num = 0;
		foreach (SkinColorDescriptor skinColorDescriptor in orderedColorDescriptors)
		{
			Color color = colorSet[num / 2];
			float num2;
			float num3;
			float a;
			HSL.RGBToHSL(color, out num2, out num3, out a);
			float lightness = (skinColorDescriptor.pairGenerationLightness > 0f) ? Mathf.Lerp(a, 1f, skinColorDescriptor.pairGenerationLightness) : Mathf.Lerp(a, 0f, -skinColorDescriptor.pairGenerationLightness);
			float saturation = (num == 0) ? num3 : (num3 * 0.666f);
			Color color2 = HSL.HSLToRGB((num == 0) ? Mathf.Clamp01(num2 - 0.05f) : num2, saturation, lightness, 1f);
			array[num] = color;
			array[num + 1] = color2;
			num += 2;
		}
		return array;
	}
}

			now.Month,
			now.Day,

public class BezierTest : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x06001949 RID: 6473 RVA: 0x0006C034 File Offset: 0x0006A234
	public Vector3 EvalBezier(List<Vector3> bezier, float t)
	{
		Vector3 v = this.LerpUnclamped(bezier[0], bezier[1], t);
		Vector3 v2 = this.LerpUnclamped(bezier[1], bezier[2], t);
		return this.LerpUnclamped(v, v2, t);
	}

	// Token: 0x0600194A RID: 6474 RVA: 0x0006C078 File Offset: 0x0006A278
	public Vector3 LerpUnclamped(Vector3 v1, Vector3 v2, float t)
	{
		Vector3 a = v2 - v1;
		return v1 + a * t;
	}

	public void OnDrawGizmos()
	{

		{
			float f = this.launchAngle * 0.017453292f;
			this.launcherVector = new Vector3(0f, Mathf.Sin(f), Mathf.Cos(f));
			new Vector3(0f, -Mathf.Cos(f), Mathf.Sin(f));
			Vector3 vector = this.launcherVector;
			vector.y = 0f;
			if (this.launchAngle > 45f)
			{
				this.bezier[0] = base.transform.position;
				this.bezier[2] = base.transform.position + vector.normalized * this.maxDist * Mathf.InverseLerp(1f, 0.70710677f, this.launcherVector.y);
				this.bezier[1] = (this.bezier[0] + this.bezier[2]) * 0.5f + Vector3.up * this.launcherVector.y * this.maxDist * 0.5f;
			}
			Gizmos.color = Color.yellow;
			Gizmos.DrawLine(this.bezier[0], this.bezier[1]);
			Gizmos.DrawLine(this.bezier[1], this.bezier[2]);
			Gizmos.color = Color.red;
			for (float num = 0f; num < 5f; num += 0.1f)
			{
				Gizmos.DrawWireSphere(this.EvalBezier(this.bezier, num), 0.3f);
			}
		}
	}

		Quaternion rotation = transform.rotation * Quaternion.Euler(this.localEuler);
		Vector3 position = transform.TransformPoint(this.localPosition);

		fxprop.body.linearVelocity = transform2.TransformDirection(this.localSpeed);
		fxprop.body.angularVelocity = transform2.TransformDirection(this.localAngularSpeed);
	}

using System;
using UnityEngine;

// Token: 0x02000037 RID: 55
public static class BossSpineTargeting
{
	// Token: 0x06000145 RID: 325 RVA: 0x000057D8 File Offset: 0x000039D8
	public static void UpdateSpineSettingsServerSide(Zombie zombie, BossProportionPreset proportionsPreset, bool hasProtectedAction)
	{
		if (!zombie.Targeting.HasTarget || !zombie.Targeting.TargetVisible || hasProtectedAction)
		{
			zombie.obj.customObj.SpineControl.UpdateSettings(BossSpineSettings.None, 3f);
			zombie.obj.customObj.SpineControl.SetSyncData(BossSpineSyncData.ResetData(3f));
			return;
		}
		Vector3 vector = zombie.obj.transform.InverseTransformPoint(zombie.Targeting.Target.Position);
		vector.y -= 0.5f;
		if (proportionsPreset == BossProportionPreset.AimGun)
		{
			vector.x -= 0.4f;
		}
		float num = Mathf.Atan2(vector.x, vector.z) * 57.29578f;
		float num2 = Mathf.Atan2(vector.y, vector.z) * 57.29578f;
		num2 = Mathf.Clamp(num2, -45f, 45f);
		num = Mathf.Clamp(num, -60f, 60f);
		float t = Mathf.InverseLerp(45f, 60f, Mathf.Abs(num));
		num2 = Mathf.Lerp(num2, 0f, t);
		BossSpineSettings newSettings = new BossSpineSettings(num2, num, BossSpineTargeting.GetProportions(proportionsPreset));
		zombie.obj.customObj.SpineControl.UpdateSettings(newSettings, 1.5f);
		zombie.obj.customObj.SpineControl.SetSyncData(new BossSpineSyncData(num2, num, proportionsPreset, 1.5f));
	}

	// Token: 0x06000146 RID: 326 RVA: 0x00005950 File Offset: 0x00003B50
	public static void UpdateSpineSettingsClientSide(Zombie zombie)
	{
		BossSpineControl spineControl = zombie.obj.customObj.SpineControl;
		BossSpineSyncData syncData = spineControl.SyncData;
		BossSpineSettings newSettings = new BossSpineSettings(syncData.verticalAngle, syncData.horizontalAngle, BossSpineTargeting.GetProportions(syncData.proportionPreset));
		spineControl.UpdateSettings(newSettings, syncData.transitionSpeed);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000147 RID: 327 RVA: 0x000059A0 File Offset: 0x00003BA0
	public static ValueTuple<BossSpineProportion, BossSpineProportion> GetProportions(BossProportionPreset enumValue)
	{
		ValueTuple<BossSpineProportion, BossSpineProportion> result;
		switch (enumValue)
		{
		case BossProportionPreset.None:
			result = new ValueTuple<BossSpineProportion, BossSpineProportion>(BossSpineProportion.None, BossSpineProportion.None);
			break;
		case BossProportionPreset.HeadOnly:
			result = new ValueTuple<BossSpineProportion, BossSpineProportion>(BossSpineProportion.HeadOnly, BossSpineProportion.HeadOnly);
			break;
		case BossProportionPreset.AimGun:

		float time2 = Mathf.InverseLerp(this.eventStart, this.eventEnd, time);
		float num4 = this.trackSpeed.Evaluate(time2) * this.speedMulti;

using System;
using Maths.Box;
using UnityEngine;

// Token: 0x0200013A RID: 314
public static class BuildingDataToVaultSpots
{
	// Token: 0x0600086D RID: 2157 RVA: 0x0001FBAC File Offset: 0x0001DDAC
	internal static void RegisterVaultSpots(float buildingBaseHeight, Vector2[] corners, Polygon.ContentType contentType, Box2D[] foundationBoxes)
	{
		if (contentType == Polygon.ContentType.Church)
		{
			return;
		}
		float y = buildingBaseHeight + contentType.RightFoot();
		int num = corners.Length;
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			Vector2 ob = corners[i];
			Vector2 ob2 = corners[(i + 1) % num];
			VaultSpot vaultSpot = new VaultSpot(VaultSpotType.Roof, VaultSpotShape.Ledge, ob.x0y(y), ob2.x0y(y), VaultPermission.Prohibit, VaultPermission.AnyClimbing, null);
			vaultSpot = BuildingDataToVaultSpots.AdaptSpotHeights(vaultSpot, contentType, foundationBoxes);
			VaultHash.Instance.AddVaultSpot(vaultSpot);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x0600086E RID: 2158 RVA: 0x0001FC20 File Offset: 0x0001DE20
	private static VaultSpot AdaptSpotHeights(VaultSpot vaultSpot, Polygon.ContentType contentType, Box2D[] foundationBoxes)
	{
		if (contentType != Polygon.ContentType.PoliceDepartment)
		{
			return vaultSpot;
		}
		float y = vaultSpot.p1.y + 0.15f;
		float y2 = vaultSpot.p1.y + 1.5f;
		foreach (Box2D box2D in foundationBoxes)
		{
			vaultSpot = BuildingDataToVaultSpots.AdaptToLine(vaultSpot, box2D.BottomLeft.x0y(y), box2D.TopLeft.x0y(y2));
			vaultSpot = BuildingDataToVaultSpots.AdaptToLine(vaultSpot, box2D.TopLeft.x0y(y2), box2D.TopRight.x0y(y2));
			vaultSpot = BuildingDataToVaultSpots.AdaptToLine(vaultSpot, box2D.TopRight.x0y(y2), box2D.BottomRight.x0y(y));
			vaultSpot = BuildingDataToVaultSpots.AdaptToLine(vaultSpot, box2D.BottomRight.x0y(y), box2D.BottomLeft.x0y(y));
		}
		return vaultSpot;
	}

	// Token: 0x0600086F RID: 2159 RVA: 0x0001FCFC File Offset: 0x0001DEFC
	private static VaultSpot AdaptToLine(VaultSpot vaultSpot, Vector3 p1, Vector3 p2)
	{
		float t;
		bool flag = GeometryUtils.DistanceToSegment(vaultSpot.p1.xz(), p1.xz(), p2.xz(), out t) < 0.5;
		float t2;
		bool flag2 = GeometryUtils.DistanceToSegment(vaultSpot.p2.xz(), p1.xz(), p2.xz(), out t2) < 0.5;
		if (flag && flag2)
		{
			vaultSpot.p1 = Vector3.Lerp(p1, p2, t);
			vaultSpot.p2 = Vector3.Lerp(p1, p2, t2);
		}
		return vaultSpot;
	}
}

	private bool TryExpandRoom(int floorIndex, int maxExpandAttempts, ResidenceRoom room, int minArea)
	{
		int i = 0;
		while (i < maxExpandAttempts)
		{
			int num = PolygonContentGenerator.rand.Next(0, 4) * 2;
			IntVec2 intVec = new IntVec2(-1, -1);

			{

			}
			if (num == 6)
			{
				intVec = new IntVec2(room.topRight.x, room.bottomLeft.y - 1);
			}
			int num2 = (num == 0 || num == 4) ? (room.topRight.y - room.bottomLeft.y) : (room.topRight.x - room.bottomLeft.x);
			num2++;
			if (intVec.x < 0 || intVec.y < 0 || intVec.x > this.initialIntBounds.x - 1 || intVec.y > this.initialIntBounds.y - 1)
			{
				i++;
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag = false;
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					if (this.initCell[floorIndex, intVec.x, intVec.y] != 0)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					intVec += GeometryUtils.directions[num];
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					i++;
				}
				else
				{
					i = 0;
					if (num == 0)
					{
						room.bottomLeft.x = room.bottomLeft.x - 1;
					}
					if (num == 2)
					{
						room.topRight.y = room.topRight.y + 1;
					}
					if (num == 4)
					{
						room.topRight.x = room.topRight.x + 1;
					}
					if (num == 6)
					{
						room.bottomLeft.y = room.bottomLeft.y - 1;
					}
					if ((room.topRight.y - room.bottomLeft.y + 1) * (room.topRight.x - room.bottomLeft.x + 1) > minArea)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

using System;
using UnityEngine;

// Token: 0x02000132 RID: 306
public static class CellCollisionHelper
{
	// Token: 0x06000857 RID: 2135 RVA: 0x0001ECF0 File Offset: 0x0001CEF0
	public static void UpdateCellCollision(HashCell cell)
	{
		if (!cell.hasContent)
		{
			cell.newCollisionActive = false;
		}
		if (cell.newCollisionActive == cell.collisionActive)
		{
			return;
		}
		cell.collisionActive = cell.newCollisionActive;
		if (cell.terrainMesh != null)
		{
			cell.terrainMesh.lodTarget.lodCollider.SetColliding(cell.collisionActive, false);
		}
		if (cell.lotMesh != null)
		{
			cell.lotMesh.lodTarget.lodCollider.SetColliding(cell.collisionActive, false);
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < cell.polygons.Count; i++)
		{
			Polygon polygon = cell.polygons[i];
			for (int j = 0; j < polygon.vegetationObj.Count; j++)
			{
				polygon.vegetationObj[j].lodCollider.SetColliding(cell.collisionActive, false);
			}
			if (polygon.HasBuilding && polygon.building.furnitureSet != null)
			{
				polygon.building.furnitureSet.SetColliding(cell.collisionActive);
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000858 RID: 2136 RVA: 0x0001EE08 File Offset: 0x0001D008
	public static void ActivateCollisionAlongLine(Vector3 p1, Vector3 p2, float sizeMultiplier = 2f)
	{
		Vector2 v = p1.xz();
		Vector2 w = p2.xz();
		MapHash instance = MapHash.instance;
		float num = instance.cellSize * 0.5f * sizeMultiplier;
		for (int i = 0; i < instance.width; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < instance.height; j++)
			{
				HashCell cell = instance.GetCell(i, j);
				float num2;
				if (cell.generated == HashCell.Generated.Done && GeometryUtils.DistanceToSegment(cell.cellCenter.xz(), v, w, out num2) < (double)num)
				{
					DebugUtils.DrawCircle(cell.cellCenter + Vector3.up * 10f, Vector3.up, num, Colors.pink, 1f, 20);
					cell.newCollisionActive = true;
					CellCollisionHelper.UpdateCellCollision(cell);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	// Token: 0x0600155C RID: 5468 RVA: 0x0005EB3F File Offset: 0x0005CD3F
	private IEnumerator ConnectToLobbyAsync(SteamId lobbyId, Action failureCallback)
	{
		DeveloperConsole.Log(string.Format("Attempting to join Steam Lobby = {0}", lobbyId.Value), LogSource.Client, LogMode.Normal, false);
		Task<Lobby?> joinLobbyTask = SteamMatchmaking.JoinLobbyAsync(lobbyId);
		while (!joinLobbyTask.IsCompleted)
		{

		{

		}
		this.ConnectedLobby = joinLobbyTask.Result.Value;
		this.IsConnected = true;

		yield break;
	}

	public void LeaveLobby()
	{

		this.ConnectedLobby.Leave();
		this.IsConnected = false;
	}

	}

	public void Show(SkinDescriptor skinDescriptor, Gender selectedGender, Color[] currentColors)
	{
		this.colorIndexing.Clear();
		this.colorIndexing.Add(new ColorSetSelector.DisplayedSlotsIndexing(skinDescriptor.HairColor, 1));
		this.colorIndexing.Add(new ColorSetSelector.DisplayedSlotsIndexing(skinDescriptor.SkinColor, 0));
		this.colorIndexing.Add(new ColorSetSelector.DisplayedSlotsIndexing(skinDescriptor.EyeColor, 7));
		int num = 2;
		foreach (SkinColorDescriptor colorDescriptor in skinDescriptor.ColorArray)
		{
			this.colorIndexing.Add(new ColorSetSelector.DisplayedSlotsIndexing(colorDescriptor, num));
			num++;
		}
		this.colorIndexing.RemoveAll((ColorSetSelector.DisplayedSlotsIndexing indexing) => indexing.colorDescriptor.GetUsability(selectedGender) == ColorUsability.NotUsed);
		for (int j = 0; j < this.colorIndexing.Count; j++)
		{
			SkinColorDescriptor colorDescriptor2 = this.colorIndexing[j].colorDescriptor;
			ColorUsability usability = colorDescriptor2.GetUsability(selectedGender);
			string translatedName = (usability != ColorUsability.NotUsed) ? TranslationController.instance.GetTranslated(colorDescriptor2.colorTag) : "";
			int textureIndex = this.colorIndexing[j].textureIndex;
			this.slots[j].ShowUsed(translatedName, usability, currentColors[textureIndex], colorDescriptor2.palette);
			this.slots[j].SetIndexing(textureIndex);
			this.slots[j].SetClickAction(new Action<ColorSetSlot>(this.SlotClicked));
		}
		for (int k = this.colorIndexing.Count; k < this.slots.Length; k++)
		{

		{
			this.items = base.GetComponentsInChildren<CraftingRecipeViewItem>();
		}
		CraftingRecipeViewItem[] array = this.items;
		for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
		{
			array[i].Hide();
		}
		PlayerInventory inventory = PlayersController.instance.MyPlayer().inventory;
		bool flag = true;
		for (int j = 0; j < recipeMaterials.Length; j++)
		{
			InventoryItem.ID id = recipeMaterials[j].id;
			int num = inventory.TotalItemCount(id);
			int num2 = recipeMaterials[j].stack * craftMultiplier;
			this.items[j].Show(id, num, num2);
			flag = (flag && num >= num2);
		}
		return flag;
	}

	{

		Color color2 = color.FadeToBlack(0.5f);
		DebugUtils.DrawCircle(p1, vector.normalized, sphereCastRadius, color2, time, 20);
		DebugUtils.DrawCircle(vector2, vector.normalized, sphereCastRadius, color2, time, 20);
		Color color3 = color.FadeToWhite(0.5f);
		Vector3 b = vector.normalized * sphereCastRadius;
		Debug.DrawLine(p1, p1 - b, color3, time);
		Debug.DrawLine(vector2, vector2 + b, color3, time);
	}

===== FILE: DiffultyRegionFinder.cs =====

using System;
using UnityEngine;

// Token: 0x02000288 RID: 648
public static class DiffultyRegionFinder
{
	// Token: 0x060012FF RID: 4863 RVA: 0x000557D4 File Offset: 0x000539D4
	public static DifficultyRegion Find(Vector3 position)
	{
		if (!MapGeneration.instance.mapIsGenerated)
		{
			throw new Exception("Reading difficulty regions without generating the map first");
		}
		Vector2 a = position.xz();
		DifficultyRegion result = DifficultyRegion.Easy;
		float num = float.PositiveInfinity;
		foreach (DifficultyRegionController.RegionLocation regionLocation in DifficultyRegionController.instance.Locations)
		{
			float num2 = Vector2.Distance(a, regionLocation.position.xz());
			if (num2 < num)
			{
				result = regionLocation.difficulty;
				num = num2;
			}
		}
		return result;
	}
}

// Token: 0x0200030E RID: 782
public class DmgIndicatorController : MonoBehaviour

	// Token: 0x060019E9 RID: 6633 RVA: 0x0006F324 File Offset: 0x0006D524
	public void UpdateDisplay()
	{
		PlayerMain playerMain = PlayersController.instance.MyPlayer();
		if (playerMain == null)
		{
			if (this.indicators.Count > 0)
			{
				this.Clear();
			}
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < this.indicators.Count; i++)
		{
			Color color = this.indicators[i].img.color;
			color.a = this.alphaCurve.Evaluate(this.indicators[i].timer);
			if (playerMain.cam.CurrentMode != PlayerCamera.Mode.FirstPerson)
			{
				color.a = 0f;
			}
			this.indicators[i].img.color = color;
			this.indicators[i].transform.localScale = new Vector3(1f, this.scaleCurve.Evaluate(this.indicators[i].timer), 1f);
			this.indicators[i].transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(new Vector3(0f, 0f, this.indicators[i].angle + playerMain.transform.eulerAngles.y));
			this.indicators[i].timer += Time.deltaTime * this.fadeSpeed;
			if (this.indicators[i].timer > 1f)
			{
				UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(this.indicators[i].gameObject);
				this.indicators.RemoveAt(i);
				i--;
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x060019EA RID: 6634 RVA: 0x0006F4D0 File Offset: 0x0006D6D0
	private void Clear()
	{
		foreach (DmgIndicator dmgIndicator in this.indicators)
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(dmgIndicator.gameObject);
		}
		this.indicators.Clear();
	}

	// Token: 0x060019EB RID: 6635 RVA: 0x0006F530 File Offset: 0x0006D730
	public void AddDmgIndicator(float angle)
	{
		GameObject gameObject = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<GameObject>(this.prefab, this.prefab.transform.parent);
		gameObject.SetActive(true);
		DmgIndicator component = gameObject.GetComponent<DmgIndicator>();
		component.angle = angle;
		component.timer = 0f;
		this.indicators.Add(component);
	}

		location.indoorFloor = Mathf.FloorToInt(num / getPolygon.RightFoot());
		location.indoorFloor = Mathf.Clamp(location.indoorFloor, 0, getPolygon.building.MultiFloor ? (getPolygon.building.FloorCount - 1) : getPolygon.building.FloorCount);
		Vector3 vector = location.pos3d;
		if (location.tryShiftingTowardsIndoorsOnHigherFloors && location.indoorFloor > 0)
		{
			vector = this.ShiftTowardsIndoors(vector, getPolygon);
		}
		location.indoorCell = getPolygon.building.GetCellCoord(vector);
		if (!getPolygon.building.IsInBuildingGrid(location.indoorCell))
		{
			location.isIndoors = false;
			return;
		}

		{

			box2DFromFoundation.AddPadding(-num2);
			PointIntersection pointIntersection = PointIntersection.Between(box2DFromFoundation, point);
			float magnitude = pointIntersection.edgeFacingVector.magnitude;
			if (!pointIntersection.Exists && magnitude < num + num2)

		{

			{

			{

			{

			}
			if (gridEdge.IntersectBeach(pos3d))
			{
				location.isOnBeach = true;
				return gridEdge;
			}
		}
		for (int k = 0; k < cell.nodesWithSize.Count; k++)
		{
			GridNode gridNode = cell.nodesWithSize[k];
			for (int l = 1; l < gridNode.roadPoints.Count - 1; l++)
			{
				if (GeometryUtils.PointInTriangle(gridNode.roadPoints[0].point.xz(), gridNode.roadPoints[l].point.xz(), gridNode.roadPoints[l + 1].point.xz(), pos3d.xz()))
				{

				}
			}
		}

			EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode displayMode = EquipmentHUD.GetDisplayMode(equipmentHUDSlot, equippedItem, targetPlayer);
			if (equipmentHUDSlot.IsFreeHands)
			{
				equipmentHUDSlot.ShowFreehands(this.freehandsSprite, displayMode);
			}
			else

	}

	// Token: 0x060019EE RID: 6638 RVA: 0x0006F638 File Offset: 0x0006D838
	private static InventoryItem GetEquippedItem(EquipmentHUDSlot slot, PlayerMain targetPlayer)

		return targetPlayer.inventory.GetEquipment(slot.Index);
	}

	// Token: 0x060019EF RID: 6639 RVA: 0x0006F655 File Offset: 0x0006D855
	private static EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode GetDisplayMode(EquipmentHUDSlot slot, InventoryItem equippedItem, PlayerMain targetPlayer)

	public static EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode GetDisplayMode(bool isFreeHands, EquipmentIndex index, InventoryItem equippedItem, PlayerMain targetPlayer)
	{
		if (equippedItem == null && !isFreeHands)
		{
			return EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode.Hide;
		}
		if (index.Equals(targetPlayer.arms.selectedItem))
		{
			return EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode.Highlight;
		}
		if (index.Equals(targetPlayer.arms.targetEquipment))
		{

		}
		return EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode.Fade;
	}

	public void Show(InventoryItem equippedItem, PlayerInventory inventory, Color color, bool highlight)
	{
		DatabaseItem dataBaseItem = equippedItem.GetDataBaseItem();
		this.ammoStringDisplay.SetColor(color);
		this.ammoStringDisplay.SetFontSize((float)(highlight ? this.bigFontSize : this.smallFontSize));
		AmmoStringDisplayInfo newValue = default(AmmoStringDisplayInfo);
		if (dataBaseItem.GetSubType() == DatabaseItem.SubType.PrimaryGun || dataBaseItem.GetSubType() == DatabaseItem.SubType.SecondaryGun)
		{
			DatabaseGun databaseGun = dataBaseItem as DatabaseGun;
			newValue.isGun = true;
			newValue.ammo = equippedItem.ammo;
			newValue.reserve = inventory.StoredItemCount(databaseGun.ammoID);
		}
		else if (dataBaseItem.stackMax == 1)
		{
			newValue.ammo = -1;
		}
		else
		{
			newValue.ammo = equippedItem.stackCount;
		}
		this.ammoStringDisplay.Show(newValue);
	}

	public void Show(PlayerInventory inventory)
	{
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < this.slots.Length; i++)
		{
			EquipmentIndex equipmentIndex = EquipmentIndex.Misc(i);
			InventoryItem inventoryItem = inventory.equippedItems.Get(equipmentIndex);
			if (inventoryItem.IsEmpty())
			{
				this.slots[i].gameObject.SetActive(false);
			}
			else
			{
				num++;
				this.slots[i].gameObject.SetActive(true);
				EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode displayMode = EquipmentHUD.GetDisplayMode(false, equipmentIndex, inventoryItem, inventory.playerMain);
				this.slots[i].Show(inventory, inventoryItem, displayMode);
			}
		}
		base.gameObject.SetActive(num > 0);
		float y = (num > 5) ? 100f : 60f;
		RectTransform rectTransform = base.transform as RectTransform;
		rectTransform.sizeDelta = rectTransform.sizeDelta.ReplaceY(y);
	}

		yield return BossfightCameraSequence.instance;

	// Token: 0x060009FB RID: 2555 RVA: 0x00026D18 File Offset: 0x00024F18
	public void MyUpdate()
	{
		if (!Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Escape))
		{
			return;
		}
		using (IEnumerator<IEscKeyConsumerMenu> enumerator = EscKeyManager.Consumers().GetEnumerator())
		{
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (enumerator.Current.TryConsumeEscPress())

					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

			if (num2 > 1f && num > 0f)
			{

				num2 = Mathf.Min(item.health.amount, num2);
				Damage damage = new Damage(num2, item2.targetPosition, DamageType.Explosion, new ZombieDamage(player, new Stagger(explosionSettings.dmgStagger, 1f), LimbID.Unknown));

	public ExplosionResult ExplosionResultFor(Vector3 origin, Vector3 targetPosition, Transform cameraTransform, Explosion explosionSettings, bool saturateDamage)
	{
		ExplosionResult explosionResult;

		explosionResult.direction = (origin - targetPosition).normalized;
		float num = Vector3.Distance(origin, targetPosition);
		explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor = 1f - Mathf.Clamp01(num / explosionSettings.rangeMeters);
		if (saturateDamage && explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor > 0f)
		{
			explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor = Mathf.Clamp01(explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor / 0.5f);
		}
		if (Mathf.Approximately(explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor, 0f))
		{
			explosionResult.flash = 0f;
			explosionResult.flashTurned = false;
			explosionResult.damage = 0f;
		}
		else
		{
			bool flag = Physics.Raycast(targetPosition, explosionResult.direction, num, this.expMask);
			explosionResult.flashTurned = false;
			if (flag)
			{
				explosionResult.flash = 0f;
				explosionResult.damage = 0f;
			}
			else
			{
				explosionResult.flash = (1f - Mathf.Clamp01(num / explosionSettings.rangeMeters)) * explosionSettings.flashDuration;
				if (cameraTransform)
				{
					explosionResult.flashTurned = (Vector3.Dot(explosionResult.direction, cameraTransform.forward) < 0f || flag);
				}
				explosionResult.damage = 0f;
				if (num < explosionSettings.rangeMeters)
				{
					explosionResult.damage = Mathf.Lerp(explosionSettings.dmgMin, explosionSettings.dmgMax, explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor);
				}
			}

using System;

// Token: 0x02000207 RID: 519
public class FootstepAudioPlayer : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x06000F0C RID: 3852 RVA: 0x00039E18 File Offset: 0x00038018
	public void MyUpdate(float speed)
	{
		this.curSpeed = speed;
		float num = this.frequencyCurve.Evaluate(speed);
		this.timer += num * Time.deltaTime;
		if (this.timer > 1f)
		{
			this.timer -= 1f;
			this.Play(this.volumeCurve.Evaluate(speed), false);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F0D RID: 3853 RVA: 0x00039E80 File Offset: 0x00038080
	public void Play(float volume, bool resetTimer = true)
	{
		this.index++;
		if (Luck.Hit(0.5f))
		{
			this.index++;
		}
		this.index %= this.stepClips.Length;
		this.targetAudioPlayer.PlayClip(this.stepClips[this.index], this.freqRange, volume);
		if (resetTimer)
		{
			this.timer = 0.25f;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x060007B2 RID: 1970 RVA: 0x0001CA38 File Offset: 0x0001AC38
	private void Update()
	{
		float b = FOVController.BaseFOV;
		PlayerMain playerMain = PlayersController.instance.MyPlayer();
		if (playerMain != null)
		{
			this.curZoom = this.GetCurrentZoom(playerMain);
			b = FOVController.UserDefinedFOV / this.curZoom;
		}
		this.CurrentFOV = Mathf.Lerp(this.cam.fieldOfView, b, Time.deltaTime * this.lerpSpeed);
		this.cam.fieldOfView = this.CurrentFOV;

	// Token: 0x060007B3 RID: 1971 RVA: 0x0001CAAD File Offset: 0x0001ACAD

	}

	// Token: 0x060007B4 RID: 1972 RVA: 0x0001CACC File Offset: 0x0001ACCC
	private float GetCurrentZoom(PlayerMain player)
	{
		if (player.SpawnedSkin != null && player.arms.EquippedGun != null && player.arms.fightModeCoef > 1f)
		{
			if (player.arms.EquippedGun.DbReference.adsZoomLevel > this.maxZoom)
			{
				Debug.LogError("Zoom level above maximum");
			}
			return Mathf.Lerp(1f, player.arms.EquippedGun.DbReference.adsZoomLevel, player.arms.fightModeCoef - 1f);
		}
		return Mathf.Lerp(1f, 1.1f, player.arms.fightModeCoef - 1f);
	}

	// Token: 0x060019D2 RID: 6610 RVA: 0x0006E8BC File Offset: 0x0006CABC
	private void UpdatePing()
	{
		this.pingUpdateTimer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.pingUpdateFreq;
		if (this.pingUpdateTimer > 1f)
		{
			if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsClient())
			{
				this.ping = ClientController.instance.myPingInMS;
				this.pingText.text = "Ping: " + this.ping.ToString() + "ms";
			}
			else
			{
				this.ping = 0;
				this.pingText.text = "Server";
			}
			float num = SteamConnectionsController.instance.TotalDownloadRate / 1000f;
			float num2 = SteamConnectionsController.instance.TotalUploadRate / 1000f;
			this.downText.text = "Down: " + num.ToString("0.00") + "kb/s";
			this.upText.text = "Up: " + num2.ToString("0.00") + "kb/s";
			this.pingUpdateTimer = 0f;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x060019D3 RID: 6611 RVA: 0x0006E9C8 File Offset: 0x0006CBC8
	private void UpdateFPS()
	{
		this.fpsPoolTimer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.fpsPoolingFreq;
		if (this.fpsPoolTimer > 1f)
		{
			this.accFPS += 1f / Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
			this.FPSPoolCount += 1f;
			this.fpsPoolTimer = 0f;
		}
		this.fpsUpdateTimer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.fpsUpdateFreq;
		if (this.fpsUpdateTimer > 1f)
		{
			if (this.FPSPoolCount >= 1f)
			{
				this.fps = this.accFPS / this.FPSPoolCount;
				this.accFPS = 0f;
				this.FPSPoolCount = 0f;
				this.fpsText.text = "FPS: " + ((int)this.fps).ToString();
				if (Application.targetFrameRate > 0)
				{
					TMP_Text tmp_Text = this.fpsText;
					tmp_Text.text = tmp_Text.text + "/" + Application.targetFrameRate.ToString();
				}
			}
			this.fpsUpdateTimer = 0f;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F3F RID: 3903 RVA: 0x0003AA24 File Offset: 0x00038C24
	public void PrepareFullList()
	{
		List<Furniture> list = new List<Furniture>(this.allFurniture.Length);
		for (int i = 0; i < this.allFurniture.Length; i++)
		{
			list.Add(this.allFurniture[i]);
		}
		list.Sort((Furniture x, Furniture y) => x.id.CompareTo(y.id));
		Furniture.ID? id = null;
		for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
		{
			if (id == null)
			{
				id = new Furniture.ID?(list[j].id);
			}
			else if (id.Value != list[j].id)
			{
				id = new Furniture.ID?(list[j].id);
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.Log("Duplicated furniture DB = " + list[j].id.ToString());
				list.RemoveAt(j);
				j--;
			}
		}
		this.allFurniture = new Furniture[list.Count];
		for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
		{
			this.allFurniture[k] = list[k];
		}
		list.Clear();
		if (this.allFurniture.Length < 128)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Missing Furniture IDs");
			for (Furniture.ID id2 = Furniture.ID.WoodenDoor; id2 < Furniture.ID.COUNT; id2 += 1)
			{
				if (!this.IDExists(id2))
				{
					Debug.LogError("Missing ID = " + id2.ToString());
				}
			}
		}
		for (int l = 0; l < this.allFurniture.Length; l++)
		{
			if (this.allFurniture[l].id != (Furniture.ID)l)
			{
				Debug.LogError(string.Concat(new string[]
				{
					"List out of order: ",
					this.allFurniture[l].name,
					", ",
					this.allFurniture[l].id.ToString(),
					", ",
					((Furniture.ID)l).ToString()
				}));
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F40 RID: 3904 RVA: 0x0003AC48 File Offset: 0x00038E48
	public void PrepareGroups()
	{

		for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++)
		{
			FurnitureGroup furnitureGroup = new FurnitureGroup();
			Furniture.Group group = (Furniture.Group)i;
			furnitureGroup.tag = group.ToString();
			FurnitureGroup item = furnitureGroup;
			this.furniGroup.Add(item);
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < this.allFurniture.Length; j++)
		{
			this.furniGroup[(int)this.allFurniture[j].group].furnitureID.Add(this.allFurniture[j].id);
		}
		for (int k = 0; k < this.superGroupSettings.Length; k++)
		{
			for (int l = 0; l < this.superGroupSettings[k].groups.Length; l++)
			{
				FurnitureGroup furnitureGroup2 = this.furniGroup[(int)this.superGroupSettings[k].groups[l]];

				{
					this.superGroupSettings[k].furnitureID.Add(furnitureGroup2.furnitureID[m]);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public void Init()
	{
		FXPropsController.instance = this;
		this.limitedProps = new List<FXProp>();
		this.unlimitedProps = new List<FXProp>();
		if (this.holder == null)
		{
			GameObject gameObject = new GameObject("FX Prop Holder");
			this.holder = gameObject.transform;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F65 RID: 3941 RVA: 0x0003B1D0 File Offset: 0x000393D0
	public void RegisterProp(FXProp fxProp)
	{
		fxProp.PoolID = -1;
		fxProp.transform.parent = this.holder;
		if (fxProp.body != null)
		{
			fxProp.body.isKinematic = false;
		}
		(fxProp.ignoreLimit ? this.unlimitedProps : this.limitedProps).Add(fxProp);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F66 RID: 3942 RVA: 0x0003B22B File Offset: 0x0003942B
	public FXProp SpawnProp(FXProp.ID id, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation, Transform attachransform = null, bool syncOnline = false)

	}

	// Token: 0x06000F67 RID: 3943 RVA: 0x0003B244 File Offset: 0x00039444
	public FXProp SpawnProp(FXProp.ID id, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation, Vector3 startVelocity, Vector3 startAngularVelocity, Transform attachTransform = null, bool syncOnline = false)
	{
		FXProp fxprop = this.propPrefab[(int)id];
		if (fxprop == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError(string.Format("Trying to spawn non existing Prop '{0}'", id));
			return null;
		}
		FXProp fxprop2 = this.PropsPool.Instantiate(fxprop, position, rotation, this.holder);
		GameObject gameObject = fxprop2.gameObject;
		if (attachTransform != null)
		{
			gameObject.transform.parent = attachTransform;
		}
		fxprop2.Setup(startVelocity, startAngularVelocity);
		(fxprop2.ignoreLimit ? this.unlimitedProps : this.limitedProps).Add(fxprop2);
		if (syncOnline)
		{
			if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsOnlineServer())
			{
				ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.BroadcastFXPropPos(id, position, -1);
			}
			else if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsClient())
			{
				ClientController.instance.GetSpeaker.SyncFXPropPos(id, position);
			}
		}
		return fxprop2;
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F68 RID: 3944 RVA: 0x0003B318 File Offset: 0x00039518
	public void Update()
	{
		if (Pause.IsPaused)
		{
			return;
		}
		this.ProcessProps(this.limitedProps);
		this.ProcessProps(this.unlimitedProps);
		while (this.limitedProps.Count > this.maxProps)
		{
			this.ReturnToPool(this.limitedProps[0]);
			this.limitedProps.RemoveAt(0);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F69 RID: 3945 RVA: 0x0003B378 File Offset: 0x00039578
	private void ReturnToPool(FXProp prop)
	{
		if (prop.PoolID < 0)
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(prop.gameObject);
			return;
		}
		prop.transform.SetParent(this.holder, true);
		this.PropsPool.Release(prop);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F6A RID: 3946 RVA: 0x0003B3B0 File Offset: 0x000395B0
	private void ProcessProps(List<FXProp> props)
	{
		if (props == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < props.Count; i++)
		{
			FXProp fxprop = props[i];
			if (fxprop == null)
			{
				props.RemoveAt(i);
				i--;
			}
			else
			{
				fxprop.timer += Time.deltaTime;
				if (fxprop.timer > fxprop.defaultTimeout)
				{
					this.ReturnToPool(fxprop);
					props.RemoveAtWithoutShifting(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F97 RID: 3991 RVA: 0x0003BB6C File Offset: 0x00039D6C
	private static DoorState HandleDoorInteraction(InteractableFurniture interactableFurniture, PlayerMain player, Vector3 pos, Vector3 moveDirection)
	{
		DoorState doorState = interactableFurniture.DoorState;
		if (doorState == DoorState.Locked)
		{
			if (!interactableFurniture.CanUnlockDoor(player))
			{
				return DoorState.Locked;
			}
			interactableFurniture.RemoveKeyForThisDoor(player);
		}
		if (doorState != DoorState.Closed && doorState != DoorState.Locked)
		{
			return DoorState.Closed;
		}
		float num = Vector3.Dot(interactableFurniture.refFXTransform.right, moveDirection.normalized);
		if (Vector3.Dot(interactableFurniture.refFXTransform.right, (pos - interactableFurniture.refFXTransform.position).normalized) < 0f)
		{
			if (num < 0f && moveDirection.magnitude > 0.5f)
			{
				return DoorState.OpenedForward;
			}
			return DoorState.OpenedBackward;
		}
		else
		{
			if (num > 0f && moveDirection.magnitude > 0.5f)
			{
				return DoorState.OpenedBackward;
			}
			return DoorState.OpenedForward;
		}
	}

		Vector3 p2 = Vector3.Lerp(vector2, vector3, sidewaysCentering);
		Vector3 vector6 = Vector3.Lerp(vector3, vector2, sidewaysCentering);
		if (randomizer.HitChance(0.5f))
		{

		Vector2 b2 = gridNode2.beachPoints[0].xz();
		Vector2 vector2 = gridNode2.beachPoints[gridNode2.beachPoints.Count - 1].xz();

		if (num.Equals(0f))
		{
			base.gameObject.SetActive(false);
			return;

		base.gameObject.SetActive(true);
		foreach (Transform transform in this.blurs)

			}

		}

	{

		this.center -= Vector2.one * 0.80901694f;

			break;

		case DatabaseItem.SubType.Healing:

// Token: 0x020001B1 RID: 433
public class LivesDisplay : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x06000C8B RID: 3211 RVA: 0x00030E50 File Offset: 0x0002F050
	private void Update()
	{
		int num = MatchController.instance.lives - 1;
		if (this.lastShownLives == num)
		{
			return;
		}
		int i;
		for (i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			if (this.spawnedHearts.Count <= i)
			{
				Image item = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<Image>(this.heartPrefab, base.transform);
				this.spawnedHearts.Add(item);
			}
			this.spawnedHearts[i].color = this.baseColor;
		}
		while (i < this.spawnedHearts.Count)
		{
			this.spawnedHearts[i].color = this.darkColor;
			i++;
		}
		this.lastShownLives = num;
	}

	// Token: 0x06000C8C RID: 3212 RVA: 0x00030EF5 File Offset: 0x0002F0F5
	public void Cleanup()
	{
		this.spawnedHearts.DestroyAndClear<Image>();
		this.lastShownLives = -1;
	}

	// Token: 0x060003AA RID: 938 RVA: 0x0000EBE0 File Offset: 0x0000CDE0
	public void RecalculateLevelAndTier()
	{
		int[] loadoutTiers = this.loadoutSelector.GetLoadoutTiers();
		int[] perkTiers = PerkSelection.GetPerkTiers();
		this.LoadoutLevel = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < loadoutTiers.Length; i++)
		{
			this.LoadoutLevel += this.tierScore[loadoutTiers[i]];
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < perkTiers.Length; j++)
		{
			this.LoadoutLevel += this.perkScore[perkTiers[j]];
		}
		this.LoadoutTier = this.CalculateTier(this.LoadoutLevel);
	}

	// Token: 0x060003AB RID: 939 RVA: 0x0000EC64 File Offset: 0x0000CE64
	public int CalculateTier(int level)
	{
		int result = 0;
		int num = 0;
		while (num < this.minimumScore.Length && level >= this.minimumScore[num])
		{
			result = num;
			num++;
		}
		return result;
	}

		{
			List<LoadoutDescriptor> allDescriptors = LoadoutDatabase.Instance.AllDescriptors;
			LoadoutDescriptor[] value = ignorePriceLocked ? (from x in allDescriptors
			where x.TierNumber == tierNumber && !Pricing.IsBlocked(x)
			select x).ToArray<LoadoutDescriptor>() : (from x in allDescriptors
			where x.TierNumber == tierNumber

	public void DistributeLoadoutUnlock(Zombie zombie, List<int> killerLobbyIDs)
	{
		ZombieType type = zombie.identity.type;
		int bossTier = BossfightController.instance.GetBossTier(type);
		foreach (int lobbyID in killerLobbyIDs)
		{
			LobbyPlayer playerByLobbyID = LobbyController.instance.GetPlayerByLobbyID(lobbyID);
			if (playerByLobbyID.type == LobbyPlayer.Type.Host)
			{
				TutorialController.instance.OnKilledBoss(type);
				this.TryUnlockRandomLoadout(bossTier);
			}
			else
			{
				ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.SyncUnlockLoadout(bossTier, playerByLobbyID.connection.ConnectionID);
				ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.SyncKillBoss(playerByLobbyID.connection.ConnectionID, type);
			}
		}
	}

			return;

		this.RemoveChallengeOnlyLoadouts(list2);

	private IEnumerable<ZbSteamLobby> FilterResults(Lobby[] result)

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

// Token: 0x02000290 RID: 656
public class LootCategoryProcessor
{
	// Token: 0x06001348 RID: 4936 RVA: 0x00056AA9 File Offset: 0x00054CA9
	public static LootCategory Combine(params ValueTuple<LootCategory, double>[] categories)
	{
		return LootCategoryProcessor.CombineInternal(false, categories);
	}

	// Token: 0x06001349 RID: 4937 RVA: 0x00056AB2 File Offset: 0x00054CB2
	public static LootCategory CombineBalanced(params ValueTuple<LootCategory, double>[] categories)
	{
		return LootCategoryProcessor.CombineInternal(true, categories);
	}

	// Token: 0x0600134A RID: 4938 RVA: 0x00056ABC File Offset: 0x00054CBC
	private static LootCategory CombineInternal(bool balanced, params ValueTuple<LootCategory, double>[] categories)
	{
		List<LootChance> list = new List<LootChance>();
		foreach (ValueTuple<LootCategory, double> valueTuple in categories)
		{
			int num = balanced ? valueTuple.Item1.ItemCount : 1;
			LootCategory lootCategory = valueTuple.Item1.Scaled(valueTuple.Item2 * (double)num);
			list.AddRange(lootCategory.Loots);
		}
		return new LootCategory(list).Normalized();
	}
}

			node.roadPoints[i] = nodeAndAngle2;
		}
		node.roadPoints.Sort((NodeAndAngle a, NodeAndAngle b) => a.angle.CompareTo(b.angle));
		if (node.roadPoints.Count < 3)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Road has < 3 points");
		}
		for (int j = 1; j < node.roadPoints.Count - 1; j++)
		{
			this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(node.roadPoints[0].point, node.roadPoints[j].point, node.roadPoints[j + 1].point, 12);
		}
		this.AddTeleportPointAtRoadCorner(5f, vector, node.roadPoints);
		for (int k = 0; k < node.roadPoints.Count; k++)
		{
			int num = k - 1;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = node.roadPoints.Count - 1;
			}
			int num2 = k + 1;
			if (num2 > node.roadPoints.Count - 1)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			Vector3 point = node.roadPoints[k].point;
			Vector3 vector2 = Vector3.Lerp(point, node.roadPoints[num].point, this.sidewalkProportion);
			Vector3 vector3 = Vector3.Lerp(point, node.roadPoints[num2].point, this.sidewalkProportion);
			Vector3 vector4 = (vector2 + vector3) * 0.5f;
			if (Vector3.Distance(vector4, point) < this.sidewalkProportion * this.mapGen.sizeSettings.roadWidth * 0.75f)
			{
				Vector3 vector5 = vector2 - point + (vector3 - point);
				float d = ((vector2 - point).magnitude + (vector3 - point).magnitude) * 0.45f;
				vector4 = point + vector5.normalized * d;
				this.MakeSidewalkCorner(point, vector2, vector4);
				this.MakeSidewalkCorner(point, vector4, vector3);

	public void SaveFile(PersistenceController.FileID id)

		}
		catch
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log(string.Format("Couldnt save file {0}!", id), LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, true);
			return;
		}
		DeveloperConsole.Log("Saved " + id.ToString(), LogSource.IO, LogMode.Success, false);
		if (id == PersistenceController.FileID.ProgressFile)
		{
			this.backups.TriggerBackup();
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x060018E0 RID: 6368 RVA: 0x0006A9D8 File Offset: 0x00068BD8
	public PersistenceController.LoadResult LoadFile(PersistenceController.FileID id, out string res)
	{
		res = "";
		if (!this.functional)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Cant load " + id.ToString() + ". Persistence is disabled.", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.CantLoad;
		}
		string filePath = this.GetFilePath(id);
		string path = filePath + this.fileExtension;
		string path2 = filePath + this.securityExtension;
		string text;
		string json;
		try
		{
			text = File.ReadAllText(path, PersistenceController.DefaultEncoding);
			json = File.ReadAllText(path2, PersistenceController.DefaultEncoding);
		}
		catch
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log(string.Format("Error loading file {0}", id), LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.CantLoad;
		}
		SaveSecurityData saveSecurityData;
		try
		{
			saveSecurityData = JsonUtility.FromJson<SaveSecurityData>(json);
		}
		catch
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Exception converting JSON Save file" + id.ToString(), LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.CantLoad;
		}
		if (saveSecurityData == null)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Security for " + id.ToString() + " couldnt be loaded (1).", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.CorruptedSecurity;
		}
		if (saveSecurityData.saveHash == null)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Security for " + id.ToString() + " couldnt be loaded (2).", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.CorruptedSecurity;
		}
		if (saveSecurityData.saveHash.Length != 32)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Security for " + id.ToString() + " couldnt be loaded (3).", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.CorruptedSecurity;
		}
		byte[] securityHash = this.security.GetSecurityHash(text);
		if (saveSecurityData.saveHash.Length != securityHash.Length)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Security mismatch " + id.ToString() + " (1).", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.SecurityMismatch;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < securityHash.Length; i++)
		{
			if (saveSecurityData.saveHash[i] != securityHash[i])
			{
				DeveloperConsole.Log("Security mismatch " + id.ToString() + " (2).", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
				return PersistenceController.LoadResult.SecurityMismatch;
			}
		}
		res = text;
		return PersistenceController.LoadResult.Success;
	}

// Token: 0x020002F1 RID: 753
public class PhysicsRateAdapter : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x060018F2 RID: 6386 RVA: 0x0006AE19 File Offset: 0x00069019
	public void UpdateRate()
	{
		this.updateTimer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.updateFrequency;
		if (this.updateTimer > 1f)
		{
			this.AdaptRate();
			this.updateTimer = 0f;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x060018F3 RID: 6387 RVA: 0x0006AE54 File Offset: 0x00069054
	private void AdaptRate()
	{
		if (!this.useFixedTimeAdapting)
		{
			Time.fixedDeltaTime = 1f / this.maximumPhysicsRate;
			return;
		}
		int totalRealZombies = ZombieLoader.Instance.totalRealZombies;
		float time = Mathf.InverseLerp(this.minimumZombies, this.maximumZombies, (float)totalRealZombies);
		float t = this.curve.Evaluate(time);
		Time.fixedDeltaTime = 1f / Mathf.Lerp(this.minimumPhysicsRate, this.maximumPhysicsRate, t);
	}

	}

		string hostilityMessage = PlayerHostilityMethods.GetHostilityMessage(hostility);
		string hostilityTitle = PlayerHostilityMethods.GetHostilityTitle(hostility);

	private LootTargetPosition FindPlaceForInternal(InventoryItem item, LootPlacingFilter filter, bool considerStacking)
	{
		if (item.IsEmpty())
		{
			return null;

		LootTargetPosition lootTargetPosition = new LootTargetPosition();
		DatabaseItem item2 = ItemsBase.instance.GetItem(item.id);
		DatabaseItem.SubType subType = item2.GetSubType();
		EquipmentSetType equipmentSetType = subType.ToEquipmentSetType();
		if (filter.HasFlag(LootPlacingFilter.Equipment) && equipmentSetType != EquipmentSetType.NonEquippable)
		{
			if (equipmentSetType == EquipmentSetType.Weapon)
			{
				int index;
				if (this.equippedItems.TryGetEmptyWeaponSlotIndex(subType.ToWeaponSlotType(), out index))
				{
					lootTargetPosition.targetEquipmentIndex = EquipmentIndex.Weapon(index);
					return lootTargetPosition;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (considerStacking)
				{
					this.StackMiscEquipment(lootTargetPosition, item);
				}
				int index2;
				if (item.stackCount > 0 && this.equippedItems.TryGetEmptyMiscSlotIndex(out index2))
				{
					lootTargetPosition.targetEquipmentIndex = EquipmentIndex.Misc(index2);
					return lootTargetPosition;
				}
			}
		}
		if (item.stackCount == 0)
		{
			return lootTargetPosition;
		}
		if (!filter.HasFlag(LootPlacingFilter.Inventory))
		{
			return null;
		}
		this.StackAtStorage(lootTargetPosition, item);
		if (item.stackCount == 0)
		{
			return lootTargetPosition;
		}
		IntVec2 intVec = new IntVec2(0, 0);
		intVec.y = 0;
		while (intVec.y < this.storage.UsableSize.y)
		{
			intVec.x = 0;
			while (intVec.x < this.storage.UsableSize.x)
			{
				if (this.storage.ItemFits(intVec, item2.Size(false)))
				{
					lootTargetPosition.addNewItemToStorage = true;
					lootTargetPosition.containerPos = intVec;
					lootTargetPosition.rotated = false;
					return lootTargetPosition;
				}
				if (!item2.IsEvenSized && this.storage.ItemFits(intVec, item2.Size(true)))
				{
					lootTargetPosition.addNewItemToStorage = true;
					lootTargetPosition.containerPos = intVec;
					lootTargetPosition.rotated = true;
					return lootTargetPosition;
				}
				intVec.x++;

			intVec.y++;

	private void StackMiscEquipment(LootTargetPosition lootPosition, InventoryItem item)

		while (item.stackCount > 0 && num < this.equippedItems.UnlockedMiscSlotsCount)
		{

			num++;

	private void StackAtStorage(LootTargetPosition lootPosition, InventoryItem item)

	private bool WillStack(InventoryItem item, InventoryItem targetItem)

using TMPro;

// Token: 0x02000326 RID: 806
public class PlayerMarkerView : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x06001A84 RID: 6788 RVA: 0x00071C58 File Offset: 0x0006FE58
	public void SetImageEnabled(Image img, bool b)
	{
		if (img.enabled != b)
		{
			img.enabled = b;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06001A85 RID: 6789 RVA: 0x00071C6C File Offset: 0x0006FE6C
	public void Display(PlayerMain player)
	{
		Vector3 vector = Camera.main.WorldToScreenPoint(player.transform.position + Vector3.up * 1.1f);
		base.transform.position = vector;
		string playerName = player.lobbyPlayer.playerName;
		if (!playerName.Equals(this.lastName))
		{
			this.nameText.text = playerName;
			this.lastName = playerName;
		}
		if (player.HasLocalControl || vector.z < 2f || !player.gameObject.activeSelf)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < this.markerImg.Length; i++)
			{
				this.SetImageEnabled(this.markerImg[i], false);
			}
			this.nameText.enabled = false;
			return;
		}
		this.nameText.enabled = true;
		PlayerMain.HealthState healthState = player.healthState;
		for (int j = 0; j < this.markerImg.Length; j++)
		{
			this.SetImageEnabled(this.markerImg[j], healthState == (PlayerMain.HealthState)j);
		}
		if (player.lobbyPlayer != null && player != this.lastPlayer)
		{
			Color color = LobbyController.instance.GetPlayerColor(player.lobbyPlayer.colorCode);
			color = Color.Lerp(color, Color.white, 0.3f);
			this.nameText.color = color;
			color.a = 0.7f;
			for (int k = 0; k < this.markerImg.Length; k++)
			{
				this.markerImg[k].color = color;
			}
			this.lastPlayer = player;
		}
	}

		else

	// Token: 0x0600009E RID: 158 RVA: 0x00003158 File Offset: 0x00001358
	public void Update()
	{
		ZombieDamageCollider[] array = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<ZombieDamageCollider>(FindObjectsInactive.Include, FindObjectsSortMode.None);
		foreach (ZombieDamageCollider zombieDamageCollider in array)
		{
			if (zombieDamageCollider.targetObject == null)
			{
				Debug.LogError("Found null targetObject at " + zombieDamageCollider.gameObject.name);
				return;
			}
			if (zombieDamageCollider.DmgTarget == null)
			{
				Debug.LogError(string.Concat(new string[]
				{
					"Found null DmgTarget at ",
					zombieDamageCollider.gameObject.name,
					", targetObject wasnt null ",
					zombieDamageCollider.targetObject.gameObject.name,
					"!"
				}));
				return;
			}
		}
		Debug.Log(string.Format("Good {0} colliders", array.Length));
	}
}

using System;
using UnityEngine;

// Token: 0x0200024B RID: 587
public class ScrappingUtils : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x06001093 RID: 4243 RVA: 0x0003F888 File Offset: 0x0003DA88
	public static void ScrapItem(InventoryItem targetItem, PlayerInventory targetInventory)
	{
		DatabaseItem dataBaseItem = targetItem.GetDataBaseItem();
		int stackCount = targetItem.stackCount;
		targetInventory.RemoveItem(targetItem);
		foreach (ScrappingPack scrappingPack in dataBaseItem.scrappingPacks)
		{
			float num = scrappingPack.quantity * (float)stackCount;
			int num2 = Mathf.FloorToInt(num);
			float num3 = num - (float)num2;
			if ((num3 >= 0.02f || num3 <= 0.98f) && Luck.Hit(num3))
			{
				num2++;
			}
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				targetInventory.AddItem(new InventoryItem(scrappingPack.itemID, num2), LootPlacingFilter.Inventory);
			}
		}
	}
}

	public void InitializeBar(int sectionsAmount)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < sectionsAmount; i++)
		{
			if (this.sections.Count <= i)
			{
				Image item = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<Image>(this.barSectionPrefab, base.transform);
				this.sections.Add(item);
			}
		}
		while (this.sections.Count > sectionsAmount)
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(this.sections[this.sections.Count - 1].gameObject);
			this.sections.RemoveAt(this.sections.Count - 1);

	public void SetFillAmount(int newFillAmount)
	{
		this.fillAmount = newFillAmount;
		this.fillAmount = Mathf.Clamp(this.fillAmount, 0, this.fillMax);
		for (int i = 0; i < this.sections.Count; i++)
		{
			this.sections[i].color = ((i < this.fillAmount) ? this.GetHightlightColor(i) : this.greyColor);

using System;
using System.Text;
using UnityEngine;

// Token: 0x020002CE RID: 718
public static class SerializationUtils
{
	// Token: 0x06001700 RID: 5888 RVA: 0x00062F70 File Offset: 0x00061170
	public static void PushString128(global::Buffer buffer, string str)
	{
		if (str.Length > 127)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Serializing string bigger than 128");
			SerializationUtils.PushString128(buffer, "");
			return;
		}
		buffer.PushByte((byte)str.Length);
		byte[] bytes = Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(str);
		for (int i = 0; i < bytes.Length; i++)
		{
			buffer.PushByte(bytes[i]);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06001701 RID: 5889 RVA: 0x00062FD0 File Offset: 0x000611D0
	public static string PullString128(global::Buffer buffer)
	{
		byte @byte = buffer.GetByte();
		string @string = Encoding.Unicode.GetString(buffer.content, buffer.readCount, (int)(@byte * 2));
		buffer.readCount += (int)(@byte * 2);
		return @string;
	}
}

		{
			return;

		LobbyPlayer lobbyPlayer = this.lobby.players[playerIndex];

		{

		this.OnLobbyPlayerRemoved(lobbyPlayer, flag);

	public void OnClientAuthAttempt(string version, string clientName, int connectionID)
	{
		if (!version.Equals(ZBVersion.Instance.FullVersion))
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Client " + clientName + " is not using same game version", LogSource.Server);
			this.KickPlayer(connectionID, DisconnectionReason.Version);
			return;
		}
		if (this.lobby.players.Count >= this.ConfiguredMaxPlayers)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Client doesnt fit. Max players reached.", LogSource.Server);
			this.KickPlayer(connectionID, DisconnectionReason.Capacity);
			return;
		}
		SteamId steamID = SteamConnectionsController.instance.GetConnection(connectionID).SteamID;
		if (!this.Matchmaking.LobbyHasUser(steamID))
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Client not in Steam Lobby.", LogSource.Server);
			this.KickPlayer(connectionID, DisconnectionReason.NotInSteamLobby);
			return;
		}
		if (this.ShouldBlockBasedOnFriendship(steamID))
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Client not friends with server owner.", LogSource.Server);
			this.KickPlayer(connectionID, DisconnectionReason.NotFriends);
			return;
		}
		if (BlackList.IsBanned(steamID))
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Banned player trying to auth!", LogSource.Server);
			this.KickPlayer(connectionID, DisconnectionReason.Kick);
			return;
		}
		if (LobbyController.instance.IsRepeatedPlayer(steamID, LobbyPlayer.Type.Client))
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Repeat player trying to auth!", LogSource.Server);
			this.KickPlayer(connectionID, DisconnectionReason.AlreadyConnected);
			return;
		}
		this.ClientWasAuthenticated(clientName, connectionID);
	}

	// Token: 0x06001740 RID: 5952 RVA: 0x00063C50 File Offset: 0x00061E50
	private void ClientWasAuthenticated(string playerName, int connectionID)
	{
		foreach (LobbyPlayer lobbyPlayer in this.lobby.players)
		{
			this.speaker.AddLobbyPlayer(lobbyPlayer.lobbyID, connectionID);
		}
		SteamP2PConnection connection = SteamConnectionsController.instance.GetConnection(connectionID);
		connection.IsAuthenticated = true;
		int lobbyID = this.lobby.AddPlayer(connection, playerName, SkinID.Underwear, Gender.Male, AppearanceColorsHandler.AllocateColorsWithDefaults(SkinID.Underwear), 0, false);
		this.speaker.AddLobbyPlayer(lobbyID, -1);
		this.GetSpeaker.SyncMatchState();
		this.GetSpeaker.SyncMatchSettings();
		this.speaker.ConfirmClientEntry(connectionID, lobbyID);
	}

		if (playerByLobbyID == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		NetCharacterMessage.PlayerRevive(this.sendBuffer, playerlobbyID);
		if (playerByLobbyID.type != LobbyPlayer.Type.Host)
		{

			{
				this.SendBuffer(ServerController.PacketReliability.Reliable, playerByLobbyID.connection.ConnectionID);

		}
		PlayerMain playerMain = PlayersController.instance.MyPlayer();
		if (playerMain == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		playerMain.Revive();
	}

				{

					this.eventRanFlags[i] = true;
				}

	}

	{
		float num = 0f;

		float num3 = this.playerMain.transform.position.y + 0.85f;
		bool flag = num2 < AuxiliarMapObjects.instance.WaterY;
		bool flag2 = num3 > AuxiliarMapObjects.instance.WaterY;
		bool flag3 = this.playerMain.healthState == PlayerMain.HealthState.Alive;
		if (flag && flag2 && flag3)
		{
			num = Mathf.Abs(AuxiliarMapObjects.instance.WaterY - num2) * 50f;
			num = Mathf.Clamp(num, this.minimumEmission, this.maximumEmission);
			base.transform.position = new Vector3(this.playerMain.transform.position.x, AuxiliarMapObjects.instance.WaterY, this.playerMain.transform.position.z);
		}
		if (num.Equals(0f) && this.particles == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		this.EnsureParticlesAreSpawned();
		this.particles.emission.rateOverTime = num;
		this.audio.volume = Mathf.Lerp(this.audio.volume, num / 25f * 0.03f, Time.deltaTime * 5f);
	}

	// Token: 0x060014B5 RID: 5301 RVA: 0x0005BBA8 File Offset: 0x00059DA8

		GameObject gameObject = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<GameObject>(this.particlePrefab, base.transform);
		gameObject.transform.ResetLocal();
		this.particles = gameObject.GetComponent<ParticleSystem>();
		this.audio = gameObject.GetComponent<AudioSource>();
	}

	// Token: 0x06001830 RID: 6192 RVA: 0x00065F34 File Offset: 0x00064134
	private void CalculateStatistics()
	{
		this.statisticsTimer += Time.deltaTime;
		if (this.statisticsTimer > 1f)
		{
			this.TotalBytesSent = 0.0;
			this.TotalBytesReceived = 0.0;
			this.TotalDownloadRate = 0f;
			this.TotalUploadRate = 0f;
			foreach (SteamP2PConnection steamP2PConnection in this.Connections)
			{
				steamP2PConnection.statistics.CalculateBandRates();
				this.TotalBytesSent += steamP2PConnection.statistics.SentBytes;
				this.TotalBytesReceived += steamP2PConnection.statistics.ReceivedBytes;
				this.TotalDownloadRate += steamP2PConnection.statistics.DownloadRate;
				this.TotalUploadRate += steamP2PConnection.statistics.UploadRate;
			}
			this.statisticsTimer = 0f;
		}
	}

				float num7 = num2;

				num5 /= 255f;

				num7 /= 255f;
				num4 = this.saturationCurve.Evaluate(num4);
				num5 = this.saturationCurve.Evaluate(num5);
				num6 = this.saturationCurve.Evaluate(num6);
				Color color = new Color(num4, num5, num6, num7);
				array[num3] = color;
			}
		}
		texture2D.SetPixels(array);
		texture2D.Apply();

	}

using System;

// Token: 0x02000389 RID: 905
public static class StringUtils
{
	// Token: 0x06001CA4 RID: 7332 RVA: 0x0007A7F8 File Offset: 0x000789F8
	public static bool IsNullOrEmpty(this string str)
	{
		return str == null || str.Length == 0;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001CA5 RID: 7333 RVA: 0x0007A808 File Offset: 0x00078A08
	public static string LimitSize(this string str, int maxSize, bool addEllipsis = true)
	{
		if ((addEllipsis && maxSize < 4) || maxSize < 1)
		{
			throw new ArgumentException(string.Format("String size limit too low {0}", maxSize));
		}
		if (str.IsNullOrEmpty() || str.Length <= maxSize)
		{
			return str;
		}
		if (!addEllipsis)
		{
			return str.Substring(0, maxSize);
		}
		return str.Substring(0, maxSize - 3) + "...";
	}
}

		this.Clear();
		foreach (TemporaryManualProp temporaryManualProp in aplicableSettings.props)
		{
			GameObject gameObject = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<GameObject>(temporaryManualProp.prefab);
			targetPlayer.SpawnedSkin.EquippedProps.AttachExternalItemToHand(gameObject.transform, temporaryManualProp.rightHand);
			gameObject.transform.SetLocalPositionAndRotation(Vector3.zero, Quaternion.identity);
			this.spawnedProps.Add(gameObject);

	}

	// Token: 0x06001CA9 RID: 7337 RVA: 0x0007A8A4 File Offset: 0x00078AA4
	public static void ClampInsideScreen(RectTransform rectTransform)
	{
		LayoutRebuilder.ForceRebuildLayoutImmediate(rectTransform);
		Vector3[] array = new Vector3[4];
		rectTransform.GetWorldCorners(array);
		Vector3 vector = array[1];
		Vector3 vector2 = array[3];
		int width = Screen.width;
		if (vector.x < 0f)
		{
			rectTransform.transform.position -= Vector3.right * vector.x;
		}
		if (vector2.x > (float)width)
		{
			rectTransform.transform.position -= Vector3.right * (vector2.x - (float)width);
		}
		int height = Screen.height;
		if (vector.y > (float)height)
		{
			rectTransform.transform.position -= Vector3.up * (vector.y - (float)height);
		}
		if (vector2.y < 0f)
		{
			rectTransform.transform.position -= Vector3.up * vector2.y;
		}
	}
}

// Token: 0x02000039 RID: 57
public class TransitoryReaperMaterial : TransitoryMaterial
{
	// Token: 0x0600014E RID: 334 RVA: 0x00005B10 File Offset: 0x00003D10
	protected override void UpdateMaterialProperties(Material material, float currentDuration, float maxDuration)
	{
		float time = 1f - Mathf.Clamp01(currentDuration / maxDuration);
		Color value = Color.Lerp(Color.black, Color.white, this.lightnessCurve.Evaluate(time));
		value.a = this.alphaCurve.Evaluate(time);
		material.SetColor("_Color", value);
	}

		for (int j = this.packs[this.curPack].ids.Count; j < this.taskUI.Length; j++)

	// Token: 0x060014B8 RID: 5304 RVA: 0x0005BC34 File Offset: 0x00059E34
	public void RunFor(Transform target)
	{
		Vector3 position = target.position;
		List<Vector3> list = new List<Vector3>();
		list.Add(target.position);
		int num = 0;
		float num2 = 0.75f;
		float num3 = 9f;
		while (num < 400 && num < list.Count)
		{
			Vector3 vector = list[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
			{
				Vector3 vector2 = new Vector3(UnityEngine.Random.value - 0.5f, UnityEngine.Random.value - 0.5f, UnityEngine.Random.value - 0.5f);
				vector2.Normalize();
				if (!Physics.Raycast(vector, vector2, num2, this.obstacles))
				{
					Vector3 vector3 = vector + vector2 * num2;
					if (Vector3.SqrMagnitude(vector3 - position) > num3)
					{
						DeveloperConsole.Log("Unstuck in " + num.ToString() + " iterations", LogSource.Unknown, LogMode.Success, false);
						target.position = vector3;
						return;
					}
					list.Add(vector3);
				}
			}
			num++;
		}
		DeveloperConsole.Log("Unstuck Failed with " + num.ToString() + " iterations", LogSource.Unknown, LogMode.Error, false);
	}

	public Vector2 GetHoldPosition(float normalizedTime)
	{
		if ((float)this.positionFrames.Length == 0f)
		{
			return Vector2.zero;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < this.positionFrames.Length - 1; i++)
		{
			VaultAnimation.Frame frame = this.positionFrames[i];
			if (normalizedTime >= frame.time)
			{
				VaultAnimation.Frame frame2 = this.positionFrames[i + 1];
				if (normalizedTime <= frame2.time)
				{
					float t = Mathf.InverseLerp(frame.time, frame2.time, normalizedTime);
					return Vector2.Lerp(frame.position, frame2.position, t);
				}
			}
		}
		return this.positionFrames[this.positionFrames.Length - 1].position;
	}

		this.RandomizeTransitionTime();
	}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

// Token: 0x020002A9 RID: 681
public static class WaveSpawnLocation
{
	// Token: 0x06001441 RID: 5185 RVA: 0x0005A374 File Offset: 0x00058574
	public static TerrainFeature FindFeature(PlayerMain targetPlayer)
	{
		TerrainFeature feature = targetPlayer.entityLocation.feature;
		TerrainFeature terrainFeature = WaveSpawnLocation.PickValidNeighbourTo(feature);
		if (terrainFeature != null)
		{
			return terrainFeature;
		}
		if (WaveSpawnLocation.IsValidFeature(feature))
		{
			return feature;
		}
		return null;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001442 RID: 5186 RVA: 0x0005A3A4 File Offset: 0x000585A4
	private static TerrainFeature PickValidNeighbourTo(TerrainFeature baseFeature)
	{
		if (baseFeature == null)
		{
			return null;
		}
		IEnumerable<TerrainFeature> source = WaveSpawnLocation.ValidNeighboursOf(baseFeature);
		List<TerrainFeature> list = source.Where(new Func<TerrainFeature, bool>(WaveSpawnLocation.IsRoadFeature)).ToList<TerrainFeature>();
		if (list.Count > 0)
		{
			return list.GetUnityRandom<TerrainFeature>();
		}
		List<TerrainFeature> list2 = source.Where(new Func<TerrainFeature, bool>(WaveSpawnLocation.IsNotRoadFeature)).ToList<TerrainFeature>();
		if (list2.Count > 0)
		{
			return list2.GetUnityRandom<TerrainFeature>();
		}
		return null;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001443 RID: 5187 RVA: 0x0005A40E File Offset: 0x0005860E
	private static bool IsNotRoadFeature(TerrainFeature feature)
	{
		return !WaveSpawnLocation.IsRoadFeature(feature);
	}

	// Token: 0x06001444 RID: 5188 RVA: 0x0005A419 File Offset: 0x00058619
	private static bool IsRoadFeature(TerrainFeature feature)
	{
		return feature is GridEdge || feature is GridNode;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001445 RID: 5189 RVA: 0x0005A430 File Offset: 0x00058630
	private static IEnumerable<TerrainFeature> ValidNeighboursOf(TerrainFeature baseFeature)
	{
		return from neighbour in baseFeature.graphNode.neighbours
		select neighbour.target.feature into feature
		where WaveSpawnLocation.IsValidFeature(feature)
		select feature;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001446 RID: 5190 RVA: 0x0005A490 File Offset: 0x00058690
	private static bool IsValidFeature(TerrainFeature feature)
	{
		Polygon polygon = feature as Polygon;
		return polygon == null || polygon.HasBuilding;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001447 RID: 5191 RVA: 0x0005A4B0 File Offset: 0x000586B0
	public static Vector3 GetSpawnPoint(TerrainFeature feature)
	{
		Vector3 result;
		switch (feature.Type)
		{
		case TerrainFeatureType.Polygon:
			result = (feature as Polygon).building.RandomZombieSpawnPoint();
			break;
		case TerrainFeatureType.RoadNode:
			result = HashCell.GetRandomIntersectionPoint(feature as GridNode);
			break;
		case TerrainFeatureType.RoadEdge:
			result = VendorController.Instance.MovePointAwayFromVan((feature as GridEdge).RandomPoint(Randomizer.Unity, 0.2f, 0f), 0.4f);
			break;
		default:
			throw new ArgumentException("Spawning zombie at unsupported TerrainFeature");
		}
		return result;
	}
}

	public static float GetGunNoiseRange(DatabaseGun gun)
	{
		if (gun == null)
		{
			return 10f;
		}
		float num = Mathf.InverseLerp(15f, 150f, gun.dmg);
		num = Mathf.Lerp(15f, 60f, num);
		if (gun.gunClass == DatabaseGun.GunClass.Shotgun)
		{
			num *= 0.5f;
		}
		if (gun.gunClass == DatabaseGun.GunClass.Carbine)
		{
			num *= 0.7f;
		}
		if (gun.gunClass == DatabaseGun.GunClass.Pistol)
		{
			num *= 0.7f;
		}
		if (gun.supression == DatabaseGun.Supression.Suppressed)
		{
			num *= 0.5f;
		}
		if (gun.supression == DatabaseGun.Supression.IntegrallySuppressed)
		{
			num *= 0.25f;
		}
		return num * WeaponBase.instance.noiseMultiplier;
	}

using System;
using Steamworks;
using Steamworks.Data;

// Token: 0x020002E4 RID: 740
public struct ZbSteamLobby
{
	// Token: 0x060018BF RID: 6335 RVA: 0x00069A14 File Offset: 0x00067C14
	public ZbSteamLobby(Lobby steamLobby)
	{
		this.ip = 0U;
		this.port = 0;
		this.gameServerId = default(SteamId);
		this.lobbyId = steamLobby.Id;
		this.isValid = steamLobby.GetGameServer(ref this.ip, ref this.port, ref this.gameServerId);
		Friend friend = new Friend(this.gameServerId);
		this.isFriend = (friend.IsFriend || friend.IsMe);
		this.name = friend.Name.LimitSize(20, true);
		if (this.name.IsNullOrEmpty())
		{
			this.name = "Unammed Lobby";
		}
		this.region = WorldRegion.World;
		this.country = steamLobby.GetData("country");
		this.playerCount = steamLobby.MemberCount;
		this.maxPlayers = steamLobby.MaxMembers;
		this.version = steamLobby.GetData("version");
		this.region = this.GetRegion(steamLobby);
	}

	// Token: 0x060018C0 RID: 6336 RVA: 0x00069B0C File Offset: 0x00067D0C
	private WorldRegion GetRegion(Lobby steamLobby)
	{
		WorldRegion result;
		if (Enum.TryParse<WorldRegion>(steamLobby.GetData("region"), out result))
		{
			return result;
		}
		return WorldRegion.World;
	}

	// Token: 0x060018C1 RID: 6337 RVA: 0x00069B34 File Offset: 0x00067D34
	public override string ToString()
	{
		string text = this.isValid ? "valid" : "INVALID";
		return string.Format("- ({0}) [ID {1}], {2}, {3}, ({4}/{5}), {6}, friend {7}", new object[]
		{
			this.name,
			this.gameServerId,
			this.region,
			this.country,
			this.playerCount,
			this.maxPlayers,
			text,
			this.isFriend

		for (int i = 0; i < mapHash.width; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < mapHash.height; j++)
			{
				num += mapHash.GetCell(i, j).curMaxZombies;
			}
		}
		return num;
	}

	// Token: 0x0600069C RID: 1692 RVA: 0x00017CD0 File Offset: 0x00015ED0
	public void CalculateCellZombieCount(HashCell cell)
	{
		float num = 0f;
		if (!cell.hasContent)
		{
			cell.curMaxZombies = 0;
			return;
		}
		num += (float)(cell.nodesWithSize.Count + 1);
		num += (float)(cell.edges.Count * 3);
		foreach (Polygon polygon in cell.polygons)
		{
			num += (float)polygon.nodes.Count * 0.5f;
		}
		cell.curMaxZombies = Mathf.RoundToInt(num * this.populationSettings.baseZombieCountMultiplier);
	}

			gameObject.transform.SetParent(ZombieLoader.Instance.zombiePropHolder);
			gameObject.SetActive(true);
